# National Gallery of Art

> The National Gallery of Art provides digital access to world-class art collections, including the Samuel H. Kress Foundation's European art archive and museum databases.

NGA serves as a premier cultural institution offering comprehensive digital archival materials and collection distribution for researchers and art enthusiasts. The site maintains extensive European art collections with advanced cataloging and authentication systems.

## Key Topics

- Kress Collection
- Samuel H. Kress Foundation
- National Gallery of Art
- European art
- Digital archive
- Art collection

## Digital Collections & Archives

- [Kress Collection Digital Archive](https://kress.nga.gov/): Digital archive of Samuel H. Kress Foundation's European art collection at National Gallery of Art
